answer: Dual-channel attestation via physical gateway: each agent transacts through one registered hardware inlet that signs a monotonically increasing local counter; sybil copies must either replay counters, which the meadow of replicas exposes by collision, or buy distinct gateways whose serials cluster under one funding lotus. Duplication thus becomes self-revealing: identical counter streams or correlated serial ladders surface as forks. Attacker cost: one physical gateway per identity plus detection risk from stream collision.
